text:
dev-deploy-bot: Scheduled shift: blue -> green for `api-router` at 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z. Commit 8f4b2c (v2.4.0). Change window 30m. Plan: 0% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (20m ramp). Pin: /v1/chat -> green during canary. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/router-shift
ria: ACK. Releasing notes in the release doc and will pin the SUMMARY at the top. Adding Known Issues: small reordering on streaming responses under high qps.
alex: quick question — does v2.4.0 enable `kv_prefetch` by default? that's the flag that caused a spike in staging last week.
sam: yes it does. we've set prefetch to false in the canary config for this shift. Rollback criteria: error-rate increase >3% for 5m OR 5xx absolute >1% => immediate rollback to 8f4b2b (v2.3.4).
jamie: I'll be on watch for traces and the latency dashboard. tagging @oncall to keep eyes. :eyes:
dev-deploy-bot: Preflight checks: LB drain hooks ok, backend healthy 12/12, certificate checks ok, canary VMs warmed. No outstanding migrations.
ria: small note — route pinning: `/v1/chat` pinned to green, but `/v1/embeds` remains on blue until 100%. Confirmed in router config: `pin: {"/v1/chat": "green"}`.
alex: good. Also, throttle policy for canary set to `max_qps: 800` to avoid overload.
ops-bot: If rollback triggered, pages will be sent to #oncall-sre and escalated to rotation-1.automations. Patch release notes will be auto-generated with the failing commit.
sam: runbook snippet for rollback command:
```
# rollback to previous pool
/deploy shift --service api-router --to blue --commit 8f4b2b --immediate
```
jamie: +1, I'll keep trace links pinned in the thread and share latency screenshots if trends start creeping up.
dev-deploy-bot: Shift started 2026-03-19T22:00:05Z. 25% traffic at 22:05, probes passing. 50% scheduled for 22:10.
alex: holding at 50% — p95 in eu-west went from 110ms -> 220ms after background reordering. pausing ramp for 10m to investigate. :pause_button:
